metadata.description: Shareable agent toolkit for Claude Code — skills, hooks, and MCP servers; anything packageable as a Claude Code plugin. Add this marketplace once and stay current as Chirag ships updates.

plugins.name: openai-image-generation
plugins.description: Generate images with OpenAI's gpt-image-2 via a tested Python CLI — --json mode, exit-code contract, and 4-tier API-key discovery, driven from SKILL.md.

plugins.name: gemini-image-generation
plugins.description: Generate images with Google's Gemini image-preview models via a tested Node.js CLI. Every Gemini image API knob is exposed as a flag, driven from SKILL.md.

plugins.name: website-to-skill-folder
plugins.description: Convert any website into an AI-searchable skill folder — scrapes pages via Firecrawl and generates ripgrep-searchable markdown with YAML frontmatter that agents can search without loading every page.
